WITH s AS (
 SELECT f.sale_date d, st.store_id, sum(net_amount) gross_all, sum(CASE WHEN NOT staff_purchase_flag THEN net_amount END) nonstaff, count(DISTINCT receipt_id) rc, sum(quantity) u
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st USING(store_key) WHERE f.sale_date between DATE '2025-12-01' AND DATE '2025-12-05' AND st.store_id IN (101,102,115) GROUP BY 1,2),
r AS (SELECT r.return_date d, st.store_id, sum(refund_net) rn FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st USING(store_key) WHERE r.return_date between DATE '2025-12-01' AND DATE '2025-12-05' AND st.store_id IN (101,102,115) GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT s.d, s.store_id, gross_all, nonstaff, rc, u, rn, rpt.receipts, rpt.units_sold, rpt.net_sales_before_returns, rpt.returns_net, rpt.net_sales
FROM s LEFT JOIN r USING(d, store_id) LEFT JOIN rpt_daily_store_sales rpt ON rpt.business_date=s.d AND rpt.store_id=s.store_id ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT 'rpt' src, CASE WHEN business_date>=DATE '2025-01-01' THEN 'FY25/26' ELSE 'FY24/25' END y, sum(net_sales_before_returns) a, sum(returns_net) b, sum(net_sales) c, count(DISTINCT store_id) stores, bool_or(store_id IN (900,999)) has_pseudo
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date between DATE '2024-11-25' AND DATE '2024-12-22' OR business_date between DATE '2025-11-24' AND DATE '2025-12-21' GROUP BY 2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'fact_real_stores', CASE WHEN sale_date>=DATE '2025-01-01' THEN 'FY25/26' ELSE 'FY24/25' END, sum(net_amount), NULL, NULL, count(DISTINCT store_id), NULL
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st USING(store_key) WHERE st.store_id<900 AND (sale_date between DATE '2024-11-25' AND DATE '2024-12-22' OR sale_date between DATE '2025-11-24' AND DATE '2025-12-21') GROUP BY 2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns', CASE WHEN return_date>=DATE '2025-01-01' THEN 'FY25/26' ELSE 'FY24/25' END, sum(refund_net), count(*), count(DISTINCT return_line_id), count(DISTINCT sales_line_id), NULL
FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date between DATE '2024-11-25' AND DATE '2024-12-22' OR return_date between DATE '2025-11-24' AND DATE '2025-12-21' GROUP BY 2

WITH a AS (
SELECT CASE WHEN sale_date>=DATE '2025-01-01' THEN 'FY25/26' ELSE 'FY24/25' END y, st.store_id, sum(net_amount) fact_net, count(DISTINCT receipt_id) rc
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st USING(store_key) WHERE (sale_date between DATE '2024-11-25' AND DATE '2024-12-22' OR sale_date between DATE '2025-11-24' AND DATE '2025-12-21') GROUP BY 1,2),

WITH cur AS (SELECT sku, category, subcategory FROM dim_product WHERE is_current),
lines AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, c.category AS cat_current, p.category AS cat_asof, c.subcategory, f.net_amount AS amt
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
  JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN cur c ON c.sku=p.sku
  WHERE d.fiscal_period=8 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26') AND st.store_id<>999),
rets AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, c.category AS cat_current, p.category AS cat_asof, c.subcategory, -r.refund_net AS amt
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
  JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key JOIN cur c ON c.sku=p.sku
  WHERE d.fiscal_period=8 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26') AND st.store_id<>999)
SELECT fiscal_year, cat_current, cat_asof, sum(CASE WHEN amt>0 THEN amt END) sales, sum(CASE WHEN amt<0 THEN amt END) returns, sum(amt) net
FROM (SELECT * FROM lines UNION ALL SELECT * FROM rets) WHERE cat_current IN ('Garden','Electrical') OR cat_asof IN ('Garden','Electrical')
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 2,3,1

WITH cur AS (SELECT sku, category FROM dim_product WHERE is_current),
movements AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, c.category, f.net_amount AS amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN cur c ON c.sku = p.sku
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 8 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26') AND st.store_id <> 999
  UNION ALL
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, c.category, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
  JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = r.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  JOIN cur c ON c.sku = p.sku
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 8 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26') AND st.store_id <> 999),
by_cat AS (
  SELECT category,
         sum(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN amount END) AS net_sales,
         sum(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN amount END) AS prior_net_sales
  FROM movements WHERE category IN ('Garden','Electrical') GROUP BY category)
SELECT category, 8 AS fiscal_period, 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, round(net_sales,2) AS net_sales,
       'FY2024/25' AS prior_fiscal_year, round(prior_net_sales,2) AS prior_net_sales,
       round((net_sales/prior_net_sales-1)*100,2) AS growth_pct
FROM by_cat ORDER BY category
